Title text 'Figure 10: The zone that correlates best with an NGED GSP group has 0.5 to 1.9 times the group's mean AGV, so the two series differ in level'

to 1.9 times the group's mean AGV, so the two series differ in level

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange: AGV, the energy the group takes from the transmission system, in megawatts. Blue: INDDEM, sign reversed, of the zone whose correlation with the group is highest after the national anomaly is removed (named in the right-hand title). Left: the winter week starting Monday 15 December 2025. Right: the summer week starting Monday 15 June 2026.'
